free_parameters.name: es
free_parameters.why: FlexPositConfig requires 0 <= es < base_nsize; es=0 is the only value valid for both base_nsize=1 (trigger) and base_nsize=2 (contrast), so es is held fixed and only nsize varies.

free_parameters.name: bits
free_parameters.why: FlexPositConfig requires base_nsize <= bits <= upgrade_nsize; deriving bits from nsize keeps the config valid without introducing a second free factor (the upgrade/sensitivity path is avoided).

free_parameters.name: upgrade_nsize
free_parameters.why: Equal to base_nsize so bits == base_nsize: quantize never enters the sensitivity-planning branch and every channel stays at the tested nsize.

free_parameters.name: model
free_parameters.why: Tiny CPU-only model with one 2-D Linear weight; the target guard depends only on nsize, not on weight values or shapes.

free_parameters.name: progress
free_parameters.why: Disables the tqdm progress bar (no terminal/IO dependency); unrelated to the guard.
